title: Dispatch: fail-closed registry gate and effective anti-template guard (attempt 7)
description:
The two defects left in PR #476's RETAINED CORE after the churn-stop decomposition.
They were recorded on eshyra-o9bd.19.1.6 as must-fix and had no dispatch. Without
them the rescope is meaningless: the retained core is the row model plus its
gate, and the gate currently does not gate.

Branch is cut from eshyra-o9bd.19.1.6 at c73f6bc.

=== FILES YOU OWN ===
  docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/finding-registry.json
  docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/finding-registry.md
  packages/core/src/rules/findingRegistry.ts
  packages/core/test/findingRegistry.test.ts

=== D1: findingRegistryClosureReady() IS FAIL-OPEN ===
It checks only whether rows SAY membershipStatus='derived'. It never applies the
executable-generator and snapshot validations that sit directly below it in the
same module. Worse, the suite explicitly constructs an invalid all-derived
registry and asserts the gate returns true — the test encodes the defect.

CROSS-ARTIFACT PATTERN, recorded on the parent bead: PR #477's ledger closure
predicate shipped the SAME fail-open shape, built independently in a different
round. Assume fail-open is the DEFAULT failure mode of any ready/complete helper
in this program, and write this one to prove the negative.

FIX:
 * The predicate must apply the full validation chain, not read a status field.
   A row claiming 'derived' whose query re-run does not reproduce its stored
   snapshot must BLOCK closure, not pass.
 * Return the EXACT blocker set, not a boolean alone.
 * The regression must assert blocker IDENTITIES, never a count. A count-pinned
   test passes identically for a different set of the same size, which is how
   both fail-open predicates in this program survived review.
 * Test both directions: not-ready on the real registry naming its real
   blockers, ready only on a fixture where every row genuinely validates.
 * The committed test asserting true for an invalid all-derived registry must be
   changed deliberately; record why in your notes.

=== D2: THE ANTI-TEMPLATE GUARD IS INEFFECTIVE ===
The validator rejects only a reason that DUPLICATES another or that CONTAINS the
canonicalId. The checked-in reasons evade both by using a title-substitution
template — same sentence skeleton, row title interpolated — and most invariants
use the same pattern.

THIS IS THE THIRD OCCURRENCE OF ONE FAILURE MODE in this program: a required
field filled mechanically to satisfy a validator. First exemplarJustification —
one identical sentence across 61 rows. Then PR #477's audit aliases — indep:001
to 012 cycled round-robin. Now title-substituted reasons and invariants. A guard
that a constant or a template can satisfy is not a guard.

FIX:
 * Detect TEMPLATE STRUCTURE, not just equality: normalise each reason and
   invariant by removing row-specific tokens (title, canonicalId, aliases,
   target selector text) and reject when the residual skeletons collide across
   rows above a small threshold.
 * Apply it to BOTH underivedReason and invariant.
 * Add a test that constructs two rows differing only by interpolated title and
   asserts rejection.
 * Then FIX THE DATA the new guard catches. Expect a substantial number of rows
   to need genuinely distinct text. Do not weaken the guard to fit the existing
   data — that is the failure mode this bead exists to end.

=== DO NOT TOUCH ===
 * capability targets and their qualified engine identities — eshyra-o9bd.19.1.9,
   just landed in c73f6bc;
 * membership derivation for the 64 prose-scoped rows — eshyra-o9bd.19.1.7;
 * violation predicate executability — eshyra-o9bd.19.1.8.
If a fix here appears to need any of those, report it rather than widening
scope. Scope creep is what triggered the stop rule on this PR.

=== ENVIRONMENT / CONSTRAINTS ===
npm ci first; npm run verify:worktree BEFORE committing. A sibling dispatch runs
in parallel on PR #477's files. Do not touch package.json, internal.ts,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .github/, or any script/CI file. Do not regenerate the pack
or run the importer. Do not modify any bead but your own; no bd dolt push; no
push, PR comment, or merge. The PR body is the supervisor's to fix.
acceptance_criteria:
• findingRegistryClosureReady applies the full validation chain; a row claiming derived whose query does not reproduce its snapshot blocks closure.
• The predicate returns the exact blocker set and the regression asserts blocker identities, never a count.
• Both directions tested; the committed test asserting true for an invalid all-derived registry is deliberately changed.
• The anti-template guard detects template structure after normalising row-specific tokens, applied to both underivedReason and invariant.
• A test constructs two rows differing only by interpolated title and asserts rejection.
• Data caught by the new guard is rewritten with genuinely distinct text; the guard is not weakened to fit existing data.
• No capability-target, membership-derivation or violation-predicate work is absorbed.
• npm run verify:worktree passes.
